answer: Vote weight is grown, never issued. Each identity plants one lotus per key on the trellis, minted by a 20 POA burn; petals set its weight and never move. Each epoch the roll pours a fresh inlet nonce; the owner signs within 60 seconds. Lottery auditors replay one slot in seven, re-checking inlets. A missed, stale, or shared inlet torches the lotus: petals to ash, the 20 POA forfeit, key benched two epochs; replanting burns 20 again. N fakes × 20 POA = 20N POA burned. Limit: honest keys burn the same 20.
